source_kind_detail: Issuer 'Data Download' workbook (Excel 2003 SpreadsheetML XML served as application/vnd.ms-excel, Content-Disposition filename=iShares-0-3-Month-Treasury-Bond-ETF_fund.xls), worksheet 'Distributions'. The link is the 'Data Download' href on the issuer product page (present in the captured page HTML with this fund's portfolioId 314116).
fetch_method: curl -L GET inside the default sandbox (no sandbox override), desktop Chrome User-Agent; Date header Fri, 16 Oct 2026 09:03:58 GMT; no Last-Modified header served
cutoff_requested: none: every issuer record at capture (all ex-dates are on or before the capture date)

output_columns.amount: Total Distribution (USD per share; equals Income + ST Cap Gains + LT Cap Gains + Return of Capital on every row), written with six decimals; no source value carries more than six

parsing_notes: The workbook is not well-formed XML (ElementTree stops at line 47, column 138, as the IEF capture's workbook did), so the 'Distributions' worksheet was read by regex over <ss:Row>/<ss:Cell>/<ss:Data> elements, the IEF capture's method; all 76 data rows have 8 cells. Dates parsed with format '%b %d, %Y' (0 failures). amount = 'Total Distribution'; Total == Income + ST + LT + ROC exactly (max abs diff 0.0) on every row. ST/LT capital gains and return of capital are 0 on every row, so every amount is income. No duplicate ex-dates, so nothing was summed. Every pay date is on or after its ex-date. One row has a zero amount: ex 2021-03-01 (pay 2021-03-05), total 0, as the issuer lists it; it is kept (a zero cash event), not dropped. Coverage: inception 2020-05-26, first ex-date 2020-07-01; 12 ex-dates in every full calendar year 2021-2025, 7 in 2020 and 9 in 2026 through 2026-10-01. The issuer pays the year-end distribution on a second December ex-date and lists no January ex-date, so the gaps over 45 days (mid-December to early February, 46-49 days) are not missing months. Record dates are in the source but not written to the CSV. Parsed with the Python standard library only; rows written sorted by ex-date.

cross_check.source: the same table embedded server-side in the issuer product page HTML (PerformanceV3 component, containersByNameMap.distributions.subContainersByNameMap.table.dataPointsByNameMap), parsed with html.parser and json.loads
cross_check.result: 76 records on the page; outer join on ex-date matched 76/76 with zero pay-date and zero amount mismatches. Both documents are the issuer's; no independent (non-issuer) source was checked

fund_facts_on_issuer_page: Expense Ratio 0.09% (labelled 'As stated in the Fund’s current prospectus') and Management Fee 0.09%, read from the captured product page; recorded for reference, not used by the CSV
